title: Huckleberry Sleep Log Weekly Night Wakings Trend
dataSources: brightwheel check-ins (`brightwheel:checkin`), Procare attendance (`procare:attendance`), Huckleberry sleep logs (`huckleberry:sleep`), daycare incidents (`daycare:incident`), and nanny timesheets (`nanny:timesheet`).
app: brightwheel check-in exports, Procare attendance logs, Huckleberry sleep tracking, daycare incident reports, and nanny timesheet entries streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=huckleberry:sleep night_wakings=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(night_wakings) as avg_duration, max(night_wakings) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst night wakings for Huckleberry sleep log events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture night_wakings on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average night wakings with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether Huckleberry sleep log tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
